title: Homelab AI Benchmarks
hardware: 1× NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GiB unified memory) per creative run

notes: Each creative result is a single independent run. No model was allowed a second candidate within a run.
Active decode statistics are samples reported by the inference server, not aggregate concurrent throughput.
Host memory is a post-run system snapshot, not an isolated peak for the model. Some runs overlapped model downloads.
No creative run has passed every objective check yet; failures are preserved rather than repaired after submission.

creative_runs.summary: Complete responsive delivery; the objective audit failed on a favicon.ico 404.
limitations: Decode and memory instrumentation were not captured for this early comparable run.

creative_runs.summary: Timed out after producing partial content and components; no entrypoint, styles, documentation, or build artifact.
Built a complete editorial site and used Playwright; the audit found responsive overflow, a missing favicon, and an invalid social image asset.
limitations: This run predates strict structural validation of the 1200×630 social image.

creative_runs.summary: Fastest end-to-end delivery. The site built successfully but failed the required social image and favicon checks; visual ambition was modest.
limitations: Host memory includes concurrent download processes.

creative_runs.summary: Produced a content-rich responsive site, but omitted the package lock and supplied SVG instead of the required PNG social image.
limitations: Host memory includes concurrent download processes.

creative_runs.summary: Highest observed decode speed and a nearly clean technical delivery; the objective audit failed on favicon.ico and some controls lacked perceptible changes.
limitations: Host memory includes concurrent downloads and is not the model-only footprint.

creative_runs.summary: Ambitious visual delivery, but the official build failed and the agent never used the available browser tools to catch its errors.
Stable runtime with no token-zero loop, but the agent exhausted the full hour before integration, build, or browser verification.
limitations: A diagnostic build after submission found invalid imports, JavaScript typos, and CSS errors; the submitted artifact was not modified.

arc_smoke.note: Harness smoke on one public training task. This is not an ARC-AGI-2 evaluation score.

completion.detail: Eight comparable first runs; zero fully verified; repetitions and final instrumentation pending.

Adapter tests pass; no model scorecard yet.

notes: Running rows are provisional snapshots and show the number of ARC tasks observed at publication time.
Infrastructure failures have null metrics and are never interpreted as model scores of zero.
Decode speed is the mean per concurrent request from a two-request runtime smoke, not aggregate throughput.
Unified host memory is an observed loaded-runtime snapshot on the assigned Spark nodes, not isolated model weights.
Reasoning speed is completion tokens divided by request wall time, including prefill and decode but excluding model loading.
Optimization rankings are feasibility-first; normalized scores average only feasible submissions, so every per-challenge outcome is published separately.
Agentic optimization uses real file/shell tools and repeated public development verification; the retained best solver is scored once on disjoint private cases.
